anomalies.description: A visible muzzle flash and dust plume erupt from the ground in a dry field, consistent with a direct impact or near-impact of a projectile (e.g., RPG or heavy weapon), observed at frame f5 and continuing into f6.
A dust plume erupts in the mid-ground, consistent with a near-surface explosion or impact; visible in f0 and f1.

A distinct dust cloud erupts in the distance, coinciding with a soldier holding a shoulder-fired weapon (RPG) in firing posture (frame f9), indicating a shot was fired toward that location.; A soldier in f1 is holding a shoulder-fired weapon (likely RPG) in a ready/aimed posture; no muzzle flash visible, but context and posture suggest active engagement. The weapon remains aimed through f2.
A small but sudden dust and debris plume rises in the far distance (visible in f14–f15), consistent with a secondary explosion or impact event, likely resulting from the earlier shot.
A large, bright orange fireball erupts in the field, with a tank visible to the left; the explosion rapidly expands and begins to generate smoke.
A second major explosion occurs, producing a massive column of dark smoke rising into the sky; the tank is partially obscured by the smoke plume and appears to be moving away or repositioning.

Sustained combat activity is evident: a military armored vehicle remains engaged in an active battlefield environment with continuous heavy smoke/dust plumes indicating ongoing explosions or impacts nearby; the vehicle maneuvers through the field while under fire or in proximity to repeated detonations.
A large, sudden explosion occurs, producing a massive, rapidly expanding plume of dark smoke and dust rising vertically from the ground near a military vehicle.

A large, sustained plume of dark smoke rises from a point in the field, consistent with a high-yield explosion or detonation occurring near or on a military vehicle; the smoke column expands and drifts over time without evidence of fire or secondary blasts.
